scripts.build:site: npm run build:assets && vite build --config site/vite.config.ts && node scripts/build-site.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --moduleResolution bundler --module ESNext --lib ES2022,DOM site/src/main.ts
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && npm run typecheck && node --check scripts/release-identity.mjs && node --check tests/release-identity.test.mjs
scripts.test: cargo test && npm run build:site && npm run test:identity && playwright test
